{
  "manifest_version": 3,
  "name": "agentes.chat",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "key": "",
  "chrome_url_overrides": {
    "newtab": "start.html"
  },
  "content_security_policy": {
    "extension_pages": "script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'"
  }
}
